name: zyventa
description: ZYVENTA — multi-vendor e-commerce platform (Next.js + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.dev: pnpm --filter @zyventa/shared build && concurrently -k -n shared,api,web -c gray,blue,magenta "pnpm --filter @zyventa/shared dev" "pnpm --filter @zyventa/api dev" "pnpm --filter @zyventa/web dev"
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @zyventa/shared build && pnpm --filter @zyventa/api build && pnpm --filter @zyventa/web build
scripts.check: pnpm format:check && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm test
